scientific_integrity: The exact proof uses established Johnson spherical eigenvalues and a new explicit sign comparison. Supporting small-dimensional matrix eigenspectra are numerical and not an infinite proof. No independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Only the three-capped Johnson metric on all four-subsets, n>=8. No other caps/layers, all finite graphs, or unconditional historical novelty. Independent validation absent; a plausible 1990 original source was unavailable in full.
title: Sharp spherical positivity threshold for three-capped Johnson four-subset metrics
